requirement.statement: XNL mutation diff SHALL use element #id as the identity key for node alignment and move detection and MUST NOT emit ordinary field updates for #id.

case.given: Two trees contain the same uniquely identified element under different parents or indexes.
case.when: diffNodes compares the trees in identity mode.
case.then: The mutation set SHALL identify the structural move by that #id rather than treating #id as changed payload.

case.given: A base or candidate tree contains the same effective identity more than once.
case.when: The strict mutation batch API validates the tree.
case.then: The batch SHALL be rejected with a structured duplicate-identity diagnostic before acceptance.

case.given: An element has no effective identity.
case.when: The batch runs with allow-missing or require-elements identity policy.
case.then: Allow-missing SHALL accept the absence while require-elements SHALL reject it with a structured diagnostic.

case.given: A caller submits an add, update, or delete mutation whose target is an element #id field.
case.when: The strict mutation batch API validates the mutation before apply.
case.then: The batch SHALL reject it with IDENTITY_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN, SHALL leave the base unchanged, and identity replacement SHALL only be representable as old-node delete plus new-node add.

requirement.statement: xnl-core SHALL provide an explicit mutation batch dry-run that never modifies its base input and exposes only a fully applied result or a structured rejection.

case.given: A valid base tree and ordered mutation batch.
case.then: The result SHALL contain the fully updated clone and the original base SHALL remain deeply equal to its pre-call value.

case.given: A batch whose later mutation cannot be applied.
case.then: The result SHALL be rejected, SHALL expose no partially applied authority, and SHALL leave the original base unchanged.

case.given: A delete, update, or move mutation has valueBefore that differs from the observable target.
case.then: The batch SHALL be rejected with PRECONDITION_FAILED before that mutation is applied.

requirement.statement: For supported XNL tree changes, applying the ordered diff to a clone of the base SHALL produce an AST equal to the target.

case.given: Targets containing same-level reorder, cross-level move, and a three-node rotation.
case.when: diffNodes creates mutations and the strict batch API applies them.
case.then: Every applied result SHALL equal the complete target AST, including order and parentage.

case.given: A target combines move, add, delete, attribute update, text update, and tag update.
case.when: The diff is dry-run against the base.
case.then: The applied result SHALL equal the target without modifying #id as ordinary payload.

requirement.statement: The existing diffNodes and mutable applyMutations APIs SHALL remain source-compatible while the strict transaction behavior, including rejection of direct #id field mutation, is introduced through explicit new exports.

case.given: Existing parser, path, loader, formatter and mutation consumers.
case.when: xnl-core builds and its complete test suite runs.
case.then: Existing supported behavior SHALL remain green and no consumer SHALL be forced into strict identity policy.
